title: Libfabric 完成佇列：注入、遠端完成與積壓
titleEn: Libfabric completion queues: injection, remote completion and backlog
summary: 以合成資料重建「Libfabric 完成佇列：注入、遠端完成與積壓」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付完成語意矩陣、佇列時間序列與背壓驗收條件。
summaryEn: Reconstruct Libfabric completion queues: injection, remote completion and backlog with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver a completion-semantics matrix, queue trace and backpressure criteria.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

增加容量只能延後溢出；需長期 μ≥λ 或背壓，且錯誤完成另行處理。
Libfabric 的 provider 能力與完成語意影響緩衝生命週期；本課分析 CQ 消費不足的合成負載。
optionsEn: Premature reuse requires checking the needed completion level; absence of a CQ event alone does not prove failure.

knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct Libfabric completion queues: injection, remote completion and backlog with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver a completion-semantics matrix, queue trace and backpressure criteria.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 穩定輸入率 λ 高於消費率 μ 時，積壓成長率 λ−μ；空佇列填滿時間 K/(λ−μ)。
knowledge.textEn: For steady arrival λ greater than service μ, backlog grows at λ−μ and an empty queue fills in K/(λ−μ).

quiz.question: 「完成層級分類」：若要檢查結果是否可信，哪一項提供本課的獨立驗證動作？
quiz.questionEn: Classify completion levels: Which statement provides an independent verification action for judging whether the result is credible?
options: 用每 10 ms 增量 200 或 50 個事件重建積壓；確認兩者皆不穩定。
若資料被提早覆寫，核對 injection-complete、transmit-complete、delivery-complete 的需求；CQ 無事件不是操作失敗的充分證據。
optionsEn: Rebuild backlog using 200 or 50 events per 10 ms; both cases remain unstable.
Premature reuse requires checking the needed completion level; absence of a CQ event alone does not prove failure.
CQ capacity K=4096; arrivals 100000/s, service 80000/s, changed service 95000/s.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「獨立驗證方法」。用每 10 ms 增量 200 或 50 個事件重建積壓；確認兩者皆不穩定。 與本階段判準一起判讀：遠端到達不等於遠端應用已處理；provider 能力需查證。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies independent verification. Rebuild backlog using 200 or 50 events per 10 ms; both cases remain unstable. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Remote arrival is not application consumption; provider capabilities require verification.

steps.title: 完成層級分類 · 比較擾動與量測
steps.titleEn: Classify completion levels · Compare perturbations and measurements
steps.objective: 完成「完成層級分類」的比較擾動與量測，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete compare perturbations and measurements for Classify completion levels and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
用每 10 ms 增量 200 或 50 個事件重建積壓；確認兩者皆不穩定。
回到本階段實驗：為三張事件卡寫出來源緩衝可否重用、資料是否到達目的端、應用是否已讀取。
把名義組與變更組並列，逐欄確認只改了預定條件；若需多變量，另開實驗編號。用同一單位檢查趨勢、偏差與判準：遠端到達不等於遠端應用已處理；provider 能力需查證。
steps.instructionEn:
Rebuild backlog using 200 or 50 events per 10 ms; both cases remain unstable.
Return to the investigation: For three event cards distinguish source-buffer reuse, remote arrival and application consumption.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: Remote arrival is not application consumption; provider capabilities require verification.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。用每 10 ms 增量 200 或 50 個事件重建積壓；確認兩者皆不穩定。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. Rebuild backlog using 200 or 50 events per 10 ms; both cases remain unstable.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 遠端到達不等於遠端應用已處理；provider 能力需查證。
steps.checkEn: Remote arrival is not application consumption; provider capabilities require verification.

quiz.question: 「完成層級分類」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Classify completion levels: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 名義式 4096/(100000-80000) = 0.2048 s；變更式 4096/(100000-95000) = 0.8192 s。提升完成事件消費到每秒 95000，仍低於到達率。 全部負載、量測和門檻是原創教學假設，不是產品規格。
交付完成語意矩陣、佇列時間序列與背壓驗收條件。
若資料被提早覆寫，核對 injection-complete、transmit-complete、delivery-complete 的需求；CQ 無事件不是操作失敗的充分證據。
optionsEn: Nominal: 4096/(100000-80000) = 0.2048 s; changed: 4096/(100000-95000) = 0.8192 s. Raise completion servicing to 95000/s, still below arrival rate. All workload measurements and thresholds are original teaching assumptions, not product specifications.
Deliver a completion-semantics matrix, queue trace and backpressure criteria.
Premature reuse requires checking the needed completion level; absence of a CQ event alone does not prove failure.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。若資料被提早覆寫，核對 injection-complete、transmit-complete、delivery-complete 的需求；CQ 無事件不是操作失敗的充分證據。 與本階段判準一起判讀：遠端到達不等於遠端應用已處理；provider 能力需查證。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Premature reuse requires checking the needed completion level; absence of a CQ event alone does not prove failure. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Remote arrival is not application consumption; provider capabilities require verification.

steps.title: 完成層級分類 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Classify completion levels · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「完成層級分類」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Classify completion levels and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
若資料被提早覆寫，核對 injection-complete、transmit-complete、delivery-complete 的需求；CQ 無事件不是操作失敗的充分證據。
對照「完成層級分類」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。增加容量只能延後溢出；需長期 μ≥λ 或背壓，且錯誤完成另行處理。
本階段必須重驗：遠端到達不等於遠端應用已處理；provider 能力需查證。
steps.instructionEn:
Premature reuse requires checking the needed completion level; absence of a CQ event alone does not prove failure.
Against the nominal Classify completion levels result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. More capacity only delays overflow; sustained service must meet arrivals or use backpressure, with error completions handled separately.
Reverify this criterion: Remote arrival is not application consumption; provider capabilities require verification.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。若資料被提早覆寫，核對 injection-complete、transmit-complete、delivery-complete 的需求；CQ 無事件不是操作失敗的充分證據。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Premature reuse requires checking the needed completion level; absence of a CQ event alone does not prove failure.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 遠端到達不等於遠端應用已處理；provider 能力需查證。
steps.checkEn: Remote arrival is not application consumption; provider capabilities require verification.

quiz.questionEn: Classify completion levels: Which statement gives the evidence-based disposition or re-verification condition?
options: 穩定輸入率 λ 高於消費率 μ 時，積壓成長率 λ−μ；空佇列填滿時間 K/(λ−μ)。
增加容量只能延後溢出；需長期 μ≥λ 或背壓，且錯誤完成另行處理。
Libfabric 的 provider 能力與完成語意影響緩衝生命週期；本課分析 CQ 消費不足的合成負載。

steps.title: 完成層級分類 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Classify completion levels · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「完成層級分類」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Classify completion levels and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付完成語意矩陣、佇列時間序列與背壓驗收條件。
在交接件中加入「完成層級分類」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：遠端到達不等於遠端應用已處理；provider 能力需查證。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：以合成資料重建「Libfabric 完成佇列：注入、遠端完成與積壓」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付完成語意矩陣、佇列時間序列與背壓驗收條件。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver a completion-semantics matrix, queue trace and backpressure criteria.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Classify completion levels: Remote arrival is not application consumption; provider capabilities require verification.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Reconstruct Libfabric completion queues: injection, remote completion and backlog with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver a completion-semantics matrix, queue trace and backpressure criteria. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。遠端到達不等於遠端應用已處理；provider 能力需查證。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Remote arrival is not application consumption; provider capabilities require verification.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 遠端到達不等於遠端應用已處理；provider 能力需查證。
steps.checkEn: Remote arrival is not application consumption; provider capabilities require verification.
